summary: Ryan Joseph Palmer, 35, of Vail fell ~200-300 feet on the north face of Capitol Peak while descending (chose the north face over the traditional Knife Edge Ridge); his two partners reported him missing ~7:15 p.m. Friday; Mountain Rescue Aspen response.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; DBS Helicopter Services; Eco Flight
notes: Merged 2 reports (parts: aac, news-2010-2019); date per news report; AAC listed 2013-07-19. Real Vail/PCSO release: Ryan Joseph Palmer, 35, of Vail, fell Friday 2013-07-19 ~200-300 ft on the north face of Capitol Peak (chose the north face over Knife Edge Ridge on descent); partners reported him missing ~7:15 p.m.; body located Saturday by 11 MRA volunteers + Eco Flight; recovered Sunday 2013-07-21 at 3:30 p.m. by 11 MRA volunteers + DBS helicopter to a landing zone ~8 miles away; received by Pitkin County Deputy Coroner Michael Buglione at Aspen Valley Hospital. [merge run-605: KVNF page corroborates same incident]
